# Saved Prompts
IMPORTANT! This skill is designed to save every prompt in a chat to an md file. If file doesn't exist, create it in docs/prompts.md. Use this skill every time a new message in a chat send by user.

Separate prompts with horizontal line (---) and add date and time of message in format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS before each prompt. For example:

```
----------------------------
2024-06-01
Some prompt text here...
```
